scope: Independent ordinary clause-level DPLL comparator. This is not master point-engine conformance and implements no learned-clause generation, oracle, point engine, target route or RL.

API.name: solve_cnf
API.clauses: Exact tuple of at most eight exact tuple clauses. Each clause contains at most n exact tuple (variable_index,satisfying_bit) literals. Exact integer indices are unique within a clause; bits are exact int 0 or 1. Empty clauses/no clauses are supported; repeated whole clauses retain their original indexed occurrences.
API.seed_bits: Exact tuple of exact tuple (variable_index,bit), unique valid indices. Original supplied order retained in seed_bits result; state snapshots are sorted by index. Zero is an assigned value; absence is omitted.
API.limits: All three budgets are exact positive integers. Invalid input raises ValueError without a result.

algorithm: At each node, emit enter once; then scan every clause and every literal occurrence in original order, including literals in already satisfied clauses. Emit scan only after full EOF.
First globally conflicting clause dominates any previously encountered unit clause. If no conflict, use first unsatisfied one-unassigned-literal clause in original order.

Otherwise branch at the smallest unassigned index, trying bit 0 then bit 1. Even when all clauses are already satisfied, remaining variables are assigned through this order so FOUND is always complete.

Assignments are immutable tuples. A child tuple extends the exact parent at one previously unassigned index. Every emitted assign has a finally restore of the exact parent, on conflict, success or budget interruption.

A sound unit choice has only one child; a branch has both children before finite exhaustion. First complete satisfying assignment stops the run; all ancestors restore. No proof route or expected answer is supplied.

status.FOUND: Full assignment plus complete trace of the first-solution run, with exact root unwind. This is not complete satisfying-set enumeration.
status.EXHAUSTED_FINITE_CNF: All permitted branch subtrees exhausted through complete global scans, sound units and conflicting leaves. This concerns only this finite input and seed boundary.
status.UNKNOWN: Any work budget interrupted the run. No solution or finite negative accepted; trace is explicitly incomplete.

results.solution: Sorted list [[index,bit],...] on FOUND, otherwise null.
results.state_wire: Sorted list [[index,bit],...] of assigned entries, including zero. Every event state is a fresh list, never a mutable parent authority.
results.authority: point_engine_conformance and learned_constraints_generated are always false. No mathematical/resource/ROOT/cold/runtime qualification flags are issued.

trace.scan_clause_semantics: satisfied is true iff some assigned variable equals its satisfying bit; unassigned preserves every remaining literal in input order. A false satisfied value plus empty unassigned is a conflict.
trace.restore_from_assignment: The entire child assignment state, not just its last literal.
trace.budget_reservation: Each active emitted assignment reserves exactly one restore slot, and one final finished slot is always reserved. Ordinary event exhaustion raises before emission; finally unwind uses only reserved restore slots. maximum_trace_events=1 can return only UNKNOWN finished. No trace truncation is presented as complete.
trace.finished: Always last, root state and actual final status; emitted from its reserved slot after all restoration.

work_counts.charging: nodes/enter, scans/full scan, unit_decisions/unit, branch_decisions/branch, assignments/assign, restores/restore, conflicts/dead, solutions/solution, trace_events/whole trace. literal_checks counts only each actual scan literal examination, all occurrences; validation and a nonexistent final rescan are not charged as scans.
work_counts.UNKNOWN: A partial scan may charge literal examinations before its full scan event is emitted. Such counts remain incurred work; an UNKNOWN event prefix alone cannot certify these as completed clause scans. No exhaustion claim follows.
work_counts.fairness: Literal checks and point-candidate checks are different units. Compare both raw counters and inclusive externally measured setup/search/audit/output time and memory; do not interpret counter equality as matched effort.

soundness_and_completeness.conditional_static_argument: With unexhausted budgets, finite branching strictly increases assigned-variable count, global conflict is exact, unit is necessary under the current assignment, and each remaining branch covers bits 0 and 1. Thus FOUND satisfies the finite seeded CNF and finite exhaustion rules it out. This is a Source argument, not an executed verification.
soundness_and_completeness.bounded_status: Budget interruption is UNKNOWN, never UNSAT. No general theorem-search, first-order, proof-word or point-trajectory claim.

pending_gates: ROOT actual request, same input conversion and frozen budgets/order.
External cold/terminal/caller/memory closure and complete saved output reconciliation.
Actual matched discovery/replay comparison; no contribution or speedup has been measured.
preservation: All existing engine, oracle, actual calibration and arithmetic Sources/results remain unchanged.
